summary: Two edges that are 0.37 parity and the brief does not decide, found by probe: (1) INPUT_CONFLICT compares the raw list, so `init --harness omp --harness omp --input {"harness":["omp"]}` and the same names in another order are a conflict although the selection is equal (skills install takes {"harness":["omp","omp"]} with --harness omp --harness omp); (2) when the typed --providers line was itself a clash (`--providers claude --no-harness`, `init --check --providers claude`), the hint is the corrected line and that line is refused as a clash, so "the hint runs as it stands" holds for every line that was valid before.
